articles.title: At $322 billion, the stablecoin market value exceeds the FX reserves of 95 nations

articles.title: Ex-Hodlnaut CEO charged with fraud over Terra exposure claims
articles.snippet: Singapore police charge ex-Hodlnaut CEO Zhu Juntao with six counts of fraud by false representation over allegedly misleading statements on the company’s exposure to the Terra/UST crash.
